package audit_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"example.test/auditapp/internal/domain"
	logic "example.test/auditapp/internal/logic/audit"
	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope/scopetest"

	"github.com/plutoframework/pluto-core/pagination"
	rbac "github.com/plutoframework/pluto-rbac"
	"github.com/plutoframework/pluto-rbac/identity/identitytest"
)

type events struct {
	tenant  string
	subject string
	appends int

	mutex   sync.Mutex
	entries []models.Entry
}

func (e *events) add(seq int64, kind string) {
	e.mutex.Lock()
	defer e.mutex.Unlock()

	e.entries = append(e.entries, models.Entry{Seq: seq, Type: kind})
}

func (e *events) Append(
	_ context.Context,
	execution scope.Execution,
	_ models.NewEvent,
) error {
	e.tenant = execution.Tenant().String()
	e.subject = execution.SubjectID()
	e.appends++

	return nil
}

func (e *events) AppendTx(
	context.Context,
	scope.Tx,
	models.NewEvent,
) error {
	return nil
}

func (e *events) Query(
	_ context.Context,
	execution scope.Execution,
	_ models.ListRequest,
) (pagination.Page[models.Entry], error) {
	e.tenant = execution.Tenant().String()

	return pagination.Page[models.Entry]{}, nil
}

func (e *events) Scan(
	_ context.Context,
	_ scope.Execution,
	after, limit int64,
) ([]models.Entry, error) {
	e.mutex.Lock()
	defer e.mutex.Unlock()

	var batch []models.Entry

	for _, entry := range e.entries {
		if entry.Seq > after && int64(len(batch)) < limit {
			batch = append(batch, entry)
		}
	}

	return batch, nil
}

func harness(t *testing.T) *scopetest.Harness {
	t.Helper()

	h, err := scopetest.New(identitytest.Options{
		Policy: rbac.Definition{
			Permissions: []rbac.Permission{
				{ID: "audit.write", Name: "Write", Description: "Write"},
			},
			Roles: []rbac.Role{{
				ID: "recorder", Name: "Recorder", Description: "Records",
				Permissions: []rbac.PermissionID{"audit.write"},
			}},
		},
		Permission: "audit.write",
		Members: []identitytest.Member{{
			SubjectID: "alice", TenantID: "north",
			Roles: []rbac.RoleID{"recorder"},
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	return h
}

func TestBodiesRunOnlyWithGateMintedScope(t *testing.T) {
	h := harness(t)
	port := &events{}

	err := h.Within(
		context.Background(), "alice", "north", "audit.events",
		func(ctx context.Context, e scope.Execution) error {
			return logic.Append(
				ctx, e, logic.AppendPorts{Events: port},
				models.AppendRequest{Type: "login", Payload: []byte(`{}`)},
			)
		},
	)
	if err != nil || port.tenant != "north" || port.subject != "alice" {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v tenant=%q subject=%q", err, port.tenant, port.subject)
	}

	// The actor is the verified subject and rules reject malformed events.
	err = h.Within(
		context.Background(), "alice", "north", "audit.events",
		func(ctx context.Context, e scope.Execution) error {
			return logic.Append(
				ctx, e, logic.AppendPorts{Events: port},
				models.AppendRequest{Type: "bad type", Payload: []byte(`{}`)},
			)
		},
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidInput) || port.appends != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid event reached the port: %v", err)
	}

	// A subject that is not a member never receives an execution.
	called := false

	err = h.Within(
		context.Background(), "mallory", "north", "audit.events",
		func(context.Context, scope.Execution) error {
			called = true

			return nil
		},
	)
	if err == nil || called {
		t.Fatal("non-member reached the body scope")
	}

	// The zero Execution carries no tenant: it cannot become a query
	// argument, and no value can be forged from outside the generated gate.
	var zero scope.Execution
	if _, err := zero.Tenant().Value(); !errors.Is(err, scope.ErrNoTenant) {
		t.Fatal("zero tenant must be rejected as a query argument")
	}

	var forged scope.Tenant
	if err := forged.Scan("south"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if _, err := forged.Value(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("scanned tenant became usable")
	}
}

// The stream body runs through the same scope.RunStream production uses, so
// strict decoding, close handling and the gate recheck apply to it in tests.
func TestWatchReplaysAndResumesOverTypedStream(t *testing.T) {
	h := harness(t)
	port := &events{}

	for seq, kind := range []string{"a", "b", "c"} {
		port.add(int64(seq+1), kind)
	}

	var got []models.Tick

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	err := scopetest.RunStream(
		ctx, h, "alice", "north", "audit.events",
		func(ctx context.Context, peer scopetest.Peer[models.Cursor, models.Tick]) {
			for range 3 {
				tick, err := peer.Receive(ctx)
				if err != nil {
					t.Error(err)

					return
				}

				got = append(got, tick)
			}

			port.add(4, "d")

			if err := peer.Send(ctx, models.Cursor{Seq: 3}); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)

				return
			}

			tick, err := peer.Receive(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)

				return
			}

			got = append(got, tick)
		},
		func(
			ctx context.Context,
			e scope.Execution,
			stream scope.Stream[models.Cursor, models.Tick],
		) error {
			return logic.Watch(
				ctx, e, logic.WatchPorts{Events: port},
				models.WatchRequest{}, stream,
			)
		},
	)
	if err != nil || len(got) != 4 || got[3].Type != "d" || got[3].Seq != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("err=%v got=%+v", err, got)
	}
}

func TestWatchRejectsMalformedClientMessages(t *testing.T) {
	h := harness(t)

	for name, payload := range map[string]string{
		"unknown field": `{"seq":1,"extra":true}`,
		"array":         `[1]`,
		"trailing":      `{"seq":1}{"seq":2}`,
		"wrong type":    `{"seq":"one"}`,
	} {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)

		err := scopetest.RunStream(
			ctx, h, "alice", "north", "audit.events",
			func(ctx context.Context, peer scopetest.Peer[models.Cursor, models.Tick]) {
				_ = peer.SendRaw(ctx, []byte(payload))

				// Stay connected until the server ends the stream, so
				// closing cannot race the rejection.
				_, _ = peer.Receive(ctx)
			},
			func(
				ctx context.Context,
				e scope.Execution,
				stream scope.Stream[models.Cursor, models.Tick],
			) error {
				return logic.Watch(
					ctx, e, logic.WatchPorts{Events: &events{}},
					models.WatchRequest{}, stream,
				)
			},
		)

		cancel()

		if !errors.Is(err, scope.ErrStreamMessage) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: want ErrStreamMessage, got %v", name, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestStreamNeverRunsForNonMembers(t *testing.T) {
	h := harness(t)
	called := false

	err := scopetest.RunStream(
		context.Background(), h, "mallory", "north", "audit.events",
		func(context.Context, scopetest.Peer[models.Cursor, models.Tick]) {},
		func(
			context.Context,
			scope.Execution,
			scope.Stream[models.Cursor, models.Tick],
		) error {
			called = true

			return nil
		},
	)
	if err == nil || called {
		t.Fatalf("non-member reached the stream body: %v", err)
	}
}
